item.title: DEFTONES Drop Video For New Single 'MY MIND IS A MOUNTAIN'; VIDEO
item.description: Deftones have released a new music video for their latest single, My Mind Is a Mountain (watch below). The track is part of their upcoming album Private Music, which is set to be released on August 22 through Reprise and Warner Records.

item.title: DEFTONES Tease Possible NEW SONG Or ALBUM Release With Cryptic Message During London Show
item.description: Deftones may be getting ready to release new music. During their concert at Crystal Palace Park in London on June 29, the band displayed a graphic on large screens near the stage.
